findings.issue: The member expectedAssetAmount of withdrawalRequests[requestId] (slot _99 + 1) prints as element _99 of a 'fixed array at storage 1', which here coincides with the real uint256[50] __gap at slot 1, so the text reads as a write into __gap; the same block prints the same members as stor155[concat(mem[0])].field_256 and stor[_99].

findings.issue: The request id stays a hash of a raw memory buffer and is then used through 'concat(mem[0])' keys (P4), because the 52-byte length written at the free-memory pointer is not folded (same root cause as P2, 41 call lines here).
findings.rule: With the free-memory-pointer range rule (stores at mem[64] + c >= 128 never reach slot 64), '_90 - mem[64] + 52' folds to 52 and the hash to sha3(Bytes(20, _param1), idx); a mapping key held in mem[0] then prints as that hash.
